findings.title: Away-recovery estimate runs ThermalModel.simulate_step on the event loop; the P10 replay barrier never reaches it
findings.claim: With an away override and return time set and the house below its recovery target, each optimization cycle calls ThermalModel.simulate_step on the event loop. The call comes from away.estimate_recovery_hours (coordinator._resolve_away -> away.resolve -> _apply_return, inline in async_run_optimization): 183 calls over 6 replayed cycles, and up to 96 per cycle. tests/replay.py kernel_checks stays green because none of its arms sets away.

perturbation.change: --deficit 0 (house at its recovery target, so estimate_recovery_hours returns before simulating). Alternatively, run estimate_recovery_hours via _await_off_loop.

findings.metric_definition: Calls to ThermalModel.simulate_* made outside process_worker.run_worker and off any executor thread, at the outermost kernel call, attributed to away.py, over 3 h of the synthetic-dhw-only replay with the away override active and a 12 h return.
findings.phenomenon_property: No model kernel runs on the event loop. Seam rule: the static AST list in p10_seams.py of every simulate_*/linalg/scipy.optimize call site, each driven by a replay arm that reaches it.
findings.seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round10/D14/s1/p10_seams.py [--away] (static_seams list plus loop/executor/worker routes)
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Compute the recovery estimate off the loop (worker or cached per solve), and add away and space-learner arms to tests/replay.py KERNEL_ARMS so the barrier enumerates these seams.

findings.title: pre-edit hook RELEASE_NOTES heading refusal skips MultiEdit payloads
findings.claim: The PreToolUse matcher includes MultiEdit, but the hook's program reads only top-level new_string, content and new_source. A MultiEdit whose edits[].new_string adds a '## v' heading to RELEASE_NOTES.md on a branch is allowed.

perturbation.change: --perturb: one-line edit of the text join to also read edits[].new_string
perturbation.expected_direction: refused_heading_payloads rises from 2 to 3 and multiedit_refused from 0 to 1; null_refused stays 0 (observed)

findings.metric_definition: Of the Write, Edit and MultiEdit payloads that each add '## v9.9.9' to RELEASE_NOTES.md on branch 'feature', the number for which the production hook program prints a refusal.
findings.phenomenon_property: Each text-bearing key of every tool_input shape the matcher admits reaches the hook's content checks.
findings.seam_rule: grep -n matcher .claude/settings.json, crossed with the tool_input keys read in the HPO_PRE_EDIT_PY block of .claude/hooks/pre-edit.sh
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Join edits[].new_string in the RELEASE_NOTES text, and add a MultiEdit refusal case to --self-test.
